Running it
----------
simcity.spc is a program file for the Samsung SPC-1000 (built with
z88dk).  Load it from BASIC (an emulator that loads .spc files, or the
tape); it draws a bar across the screen while it unpacks itself and then
starts.  It needs the machine's 64 KB of RAM.

The game uses the MC6847's 256 x 192 black and white mode and, for the
mini maps, its 128 x 192 four colour mode.  Sound is on the AY.

Saving a city writes it to the cassette in the machine's own format (so
BASIC can read it), and loading reads it back: press RECORD and PLAY (or
PLAY), then a key; Shift+Break stops a tape operation.  This is untested
on real hardware.

Keys
----
  Cursor keys     move the cursor one square (shifted: eight)
  O P Q A         left, right, up, down
  Space, Enter    build with the tool
  , .             the previous and next tool
  0 - 9           choose a tool by its number
  H               pause or run
  + -             faster, slower
  M               the next mini map (X goes back to the city)
  B               the budget            V   the evaluation
  S               save the city         L   load a city
  X               the game menu: new city, options, disasters
